name: Door Frame Interstage (Between Coats)
intent: Inspect the cured first finish coat on each frame, sand between coats, patch any defects revealed by the first coat, spot-coat patches, clean dust before the second coat. Door frames always get interstage regardless of QT because they take semigloss/satin finishes that reveal surface texture.
doctrine: Door frame interstage is mandatory at all QTs, like trim. Rates scaled from trim interstage (800/400/400/500/600 LF/hr) using 17 LF/frame ratio; rounded for reasonable EA/hr values. Gap-fill estimates — validate with Phase 2 field data.
